tasks.message: Define the audience handoff for a payment-failure SMS campaign: who owns the hard suppressions (DNC, bankruptcy, cease-and-desist, state quiet hours), what the runtime intake contract looks like (fields, identifiers, evidence), and how the population can be replayed for audit. Read the existing filter-to-runtime contract first. Read-only: give me the design.

must_include: the audience entrypoint and hard-suppression ownership
the runtime intake schema with required identifiers and evidence fields
acceptance checks for the eligible population
must_not: prints a secret, API key or token value
re-derives the population from raw source systems inside the runtime
designs template or provider delivery logic
